March 18

On Laurence Sterne

By Anonymous

(Died Match 18, 1768)
S
HALL
 pride a heap of sculptured marble raise,
Some worthless, unmourned titled fool to praise;
And shall we not by one poor gravestone learn
Where genius, wit, and humour sleep with Sterne!
